description.message: Lets Fontexto download a cited work's PDF with your own access (university network, library login). Only PDFs, only for the DOIs Fontexto asks for.

popupIntro.message: When a reference has no free copy, Fontexto asks this extension to download the PDF with your own access: your university network, your library login or a publisher account. Nothing goes through Fontexto's servers.

prefixHint.message: Your library's proxy prefix (EZproxy or similar). Use {url} or {doi} if it needs them in the middle of the link. Leave it empty if you are on the university network.

invalid.message: This is not a valid link.

privacy.message: The extension only works on fontexto.com, only resolves DOIs, and only hands back PDFs.
